items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday; consecutive DNPs put Week 5 status in serious doubt vs JAX (London), week-to-week.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs after early exit prior week

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) DNP again Thursday after missing prior; consecutive absences make Week 5 availability highly doubtful.
items.implication: Thin Eagles WR room further; monitor Wicks too

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) did not practice Thursday; Friday practice is key for Sunday Night availability vs ATL.
items.implication: Monitor Fri closely; must-start if active, backup path if out

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis) injury; coach says he will miss multiple weeks.
items.implication: Remove from lineups ROS short-term; DK Metcalf volume up

items.text: Bucky Irving delivered career-best 21-165-1 rushing plus 2-10-1 receiving in TNF win vs DAL, including first goal-line snaps of season leading to both TDs and 72-yard burst; early-down share strong, short-yardage role expanded vs prior Tucker/Gainwell lean.
items.why: Goal-line and short-yardage opportunity expansion plus volume in win with rookie QB
items.implication: Volatile RB2 floor rises with confirmed early-down + GL work; monitor glute but cleared postgame

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Monitor; volume to others if limited/out

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot) after Wednesday DNP; status vs DEN uncertain.
items.implication: Downgrade pending Fri; targets to others if out

items.text: Bears RB D’Andre Swift limited Thursday (knee/hip); Kyle Monangai DNP second straight day (thumb/toe).
items.implication: Swift still lead but monitor share; Monangai handcuff cloudy

items.text: Adam Levitan notes Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming on theirs (xFP data).
items.implication: Sustain/regression watch; buy Bijan/Kyren efficiency, caution Jeanty/Chase Brown overperform risk reverse
items.conflict: Berry LOVE on Chase Brown vs under xFP

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs TEN as his WR8; volume and red-zone work vs soft secondary.
Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injury cascade potential and soft run D.
Berry loves Christian Watson vs CHI as WR15 on coverage/positional matchup edges.
Berry loves Isaiah Likely @ WSH as TE5; positional matchup advantage.
items.implication: Strong TE1/2 play (esp if Andrews faded)

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison @ NO as WR41; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
